text:
Diego: Heads up 7: corpcard declined for the rental car pre-auth at Hertz SFO (pre-auth $250). I paid the deposit on my personal AmEx ending 6789 and completed the rental. Attached: rental_agreement.pdf and receipt.jpg.
Priya - Finance: Sorry about the hassle. For rental deposits we need the itemized rental agreement showing the hold/release language and the final receipt. The pre-auth hold usually clears in ~7 days but we can reimburse the deposit OOP if you prefer. Did you get the hold reference number?
Diego: I have the agreement with reservation #R-9X2PQ and the pict of the POS terminal that shows "hold posted". Put in expense as personal card. Prefer reimbursement now.
Lina - Manager: Approving reimbursement. @Priya - Finance please expedite. Also confirm chargeback risk if corpcard got declined mid-rental.
Priya - Finance: Approved by manager, thanks. Process as "OOP pre-auth exception" and tag with `TR_RENTAL`. We need: 1) final itemized receipt (total + taxes), 2) rental agreement showing hold, 3) short note in Concur explaining corpcard decline. If you already attached both files mention them in the note.
Diego: Uploaded files and submitted Concur form ID EX-2026-0422-4510. Note says: "corpcard declined, personal AmEx used for deposit; reservation R-9X2PQ; manager Lina approved."
CardOpsBot: New ticket created: CORP-CARD-11234 for issuer decline investigation. Please include transaction trace if available.
Priya - Finance: I'll queue this for expedited reimbursement. If the pre-auth clears and posts back to the corpcard we will reconcile and reverse the OOP reimbursement. Otherwise we finalize. Expect payment in 3-6 business days.
ExpenseBot: Expense EX-2026-0422-4510 submitted by Diego at 2026-04-22 10:05 UTC. Status: awaiting finance processing.
Diego: Thanks. Any tips to avoid this in future? It was a foreign rental but charged in USD.
Priya - Finance: CardOps suggests carrying backup virtual card or asking front-desk to run as rental charge instead of pre-auth when possible. Also confirm MCC not blocked for rentals. We'll follow up in the CORP-CARD ticket.
Lina - Manager: Great 1: closing once reimbursed.
Diego: Appreciated, leaving this here for audit trail.
